_comment: Single source of truth for the current monthly workshop. Edited each month by the workshop skill, then used to regenerate the funnel. Date is Melbourne local; the skill works out the timezone (AEST/AEDT) automatically.
title: The Unfair Advantage
calendarDescription: A free hands-along hour with Kelly at Wise Women Use AI. Watch Claude build the first home for your business, just by talking to it.

thankYou.whatWeDoingSub: One hour. You talk, Claude builds. Nothing to set up alone.

cards.title: Claude and Notion, connected
cards.body: We'll link the two together on the day, so Claude can start building the first home for your business.

cards.title: Your business HQ, built live while you talk
cards.body: What your business is, who it's for, what you sell, and a brain dump to catch everything rattling round your head.

cards.title: The exact prompt to get you started
cards.body: Yours to keep and run again any time, so you're never starting from a blank page.

cards.title: A home you actually own
cards.body: Not locked in your head, not tied to one tool. Your second brain, and your backup.

thankYou.beforeSub: A few things that'll make the hour more useful for you.

steps.title: Have Claude and Notion ready, if you'd like to build along
steps.body: A Claude Pro account and a Notion account, and we'll connect them on the day. Don't have them yet, or would rather just watch? That's completely fine, come as you are and keep the step-by-step for after.

steps.title: Bring the basics of your business in your head
steps.body: What it is, who it's for, what you sell. Plus anything rattling round that you've been meaning to write down. That's your raw material for the brain dump.

steps.title: Come with your camera off and your tea on
steps.body: No hot seats, no homework before you arrive. Just show up.

topic: Your content system, off your plate
holdingTeaser: Stop carrying the content in your head. In one hour we build a system that carries it for you.
